title: Taking a trumpet-only job at the Patsilla and Joe Harris
summary: A bandleader asked him to bring his trumpet to a job with no sax; Russ organized a five-piece band and from then on played trumpet.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
